answer:
Decision: IMPASSE

The Security Council adopted resolution 2682 (2023), extending UNAMI's mandate to 31 May 2024 and requesting a strategic review by 31 March 2024. The UK delegate mandates a shortened term, accepting only options C and D. The France delegate mandates retaining the term, accepting only options A and B. No single option satisfies both delegates. Consequently, the workshop cannot reach a consensus on a future action. The historical adoption of the mandate remains valid, but the proposed workshop actions are incompatible with the conflicting mandates of the participating delegates.
